description: Collecting voice samples from a meeting: who may collect, add, hear and delete.

preconditions: In-person Published meeting; actor is its current secretary.
Person is an active participant consented to notice "1.3" with 2 collected samples.
Audio holds 20 seconds of one clear voice.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: its current secretary; userId: a consented participant; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Success with the collected sample (MSG473 "Đã lưu giọng mẫu thu hộ."); the sample belongs to the person recorded, with the meeting and the secretary on it.
cases.log: Saved: encrypted sample always with its recording; notification "Thư ký đã thu giọng mẫu của bạn" to the person; audit row records the collection with the meeting scope.
cases.note: UC-86b · BR-452 · BR-453 · MSG473 · Pending: needs the live speech worker to embed a clear voice sample.

preconditions: Meeting exists; actor takes part in it but is not the current secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: a member who is not the secretary; userId: a participant; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; without the secretary role the request is answered as if the meeting does not exist.

preconditions: Actor is the current secretary; the person never consented.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: its current secretary; userId: a participant without consent; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure NoConsent (MSG475 "Người này chưa đồng ý dùng Voice ID theo điều khoản mới. Họ bật ở trang Giọng nói của tôi."); the audio never goes to the worker.

preconditions: Actor is the current secretary; the person consented to notice "1.2".
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: its current secretary; userId: a participant consented to "1.2"; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure NoConsent (MSG475); only a consent to notice 1.3 or later names this collection.

preconditions: Actor is the current secretary; the person already has 5 collected samples.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: its current secretary; userId: a participant with 5 collected samples; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure LimitReached (MSG476 "Người này đã đủ 5 giọng mẫu thu hộ. Xoá bớt mẫu thu ở cuộc họp này rồi thu lại."); nothing is kept.

preconditions: Meeting status is Ended; actor is its secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an Ended meeting; actorId: its secretary; userId: a consented participant; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure NotCollectable (MSG477 "Chỉ thu giọng mẫu hộ khi cuộc họp đã công bố hoặc đang họp.").

preconditions: Actor is the current secretary; the target is a guest without an account.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: its current secretary; userId: a guest; audio: a voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; a guest has no Voice ID to keep a sample under.

preconditions: Actor is the current secretary; the person consented to notice "1.3".
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: its current secretary; userId: a consented participant; audio: a 3-second recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure Rejected (MSG309); errors[file] = ["Giọng mẫu quá ngắn — cần ít nhất 6 giây có tiếng nói. Hãy đọc hết đoạn văn mẫu."]; nothing is kept.
cases.note: UC-86b · BR-363 · MSG309 · Pending: needs the live speech worker to judge speech length.

preconditions: Actor is the current secretary; the person consented to notice "1.3".
cases.inputs: meetingId: a Published meeting; actorId: its current secretary; userId: a consented participant; audio: a clear voice recording; contentType: audio/mpeg.
cases.return: Failure EngineUnavailable (MSG312 "Máy chủ nhận dạng giọng nói chưa sẵn sàng. Vui lòng thử lại sau."); nothing is kept.
cases.log: Warning logged with the meeting id.
cases.note: UC-86b · MSG312 · Pending: needs a live speech worker in a down state.
